all_three_observed_goal_intersection.scope: Post hoc same-goal×repetition observed intersection only; does not replace fixed21 denominators or prove whole-population superiority.

same_peak_memory.incomplete_definition: No same-sample observation of both registered Python/Rust roles in this trial. Separate from GOAL_FAILED/functional failures; zero does not prove every sample or true peak was fully observed.
same_peak_memory.scope: One actual max concurrent sample across trials; initial sample is fresh-run startup, not steady baseline. Logical serialized bytes overlap and do not partition RSS. Experiment events/calls are evidence overhead. Nominal 50ms ps RSS, shared-page dedup unverified; excludes UI, outer orchestrator, cloud weights.

rows.scope: Each alternative12 authored episodes. Preparation completed before following request stimuli; request times are prepared-state observations. Stage cost includes all preparation, request, repair and receiver calls. Source-file read calls are not physical IO. Full wall/receiver union are conditional on actual observed completion.
